camera_registration: RANSAC background affine from each neighbor directly to target; quality>=0.35. Withhold temporal reranking if either immediate neighbor fails registration.
policy: For every target detector candidate, evaluate all pairs of preceding/following candidates at +/-3. Reward a high-scoring short path whose linearly interpolated center agrees with the target candidate; use +/-6 to reward constant-velocity continuation. Reject implied speed above140native px/frame. Target output always remains an unchanged detector candidate passing the frozen operating point. No labels enter ranking.
selection: Report every variant; no parameter choice from these test scores and no default replay change.
scope: Exploratory temporal reranking on120 previously opened samples. Unknown reference frames are excluded. Does not establish full-video accuracy.
